summary: Computes a normalized brake thermal factor clamped to [0,1]. Forms a suspension displacement residual from a rotation-row dot product with an anchor point, squares it, applies two thermal conversion factors divided by a heat-capacity term, subtracts an offset and divides by a range denominator. Returns 0.0 when either divisor is zero.

operations.description: If this+0x39C8 equals 0.0, return 0.0 (avoids division by the thermal capacity divisor).
If this+0x39AC equals 0.0, return 0.0 (avoids division by the range denominator).
Dot product of rotation-matrix row components (this+0x34B8, this+0x34C4, this+0x34D0) with the local anchor point (this+0x3A58, this+0x3A5C, this+0x3A60).
v2 = this+0x3500 minus the dot product above (residual displacement term).

result = (v2 * this+0x3D44 * v2 * this+0x3D40 / this+0x39C8 - this+0x39A8) / this+0x39AC (squared residual scaled by two factors, divided by thermal capacity, minus offset, divided by range denominator).
Return the clamped normalized thermal factor.
